About me

I'm a high school student interested in programming, hardware and looking after operating systems. I like solving problems, however big or small - whether it's a clogged-up Windows or a mod for a game long forgotten. I enjoy working in Inkscape, Photoshop, Paint.NET and Blender, and looking after and building computers. I experiment with different technologies and programming languages, and keep adding new projects to my portfolio.
